name: SKAM España
description: The series accompanies a group of 16-year-olds on the journey of their life following their day to day in real time. Dependence on social media, how they face sex, love and ruptures, religion, the search of their identity and the need to fit in.

videos.title: The weirdos of high school
videos.overview: Eva goes back to high school and it’s her turn to face reality: she’s alone, has no friends and her boyfriend Jorge seems to ignore her.

videos.title: It's a mess
videos.overview: Second year boy, Cristian, flirts with Eva. She is pressured by the rest of the girls to be invited to the party that is at his.

videos.title: Show me your phone
videos.overview: Eva mistrusts Jorge and his excuses. Meanwhile, Viri is in a cloud after her mess with Alejandro.

videos.title: Truth or dare
videos.overview: After their last argument, Eva and Jorge don't talk. The girls encourage Viri to finally forget Alejandro.

videos.title: And how am I?
videos.overview: The holidays arrives and Cris invites all the girls to her village. But Eva and Jorge are looking forward to spending time together and decide to leave alone for a romantic getaway, but nothing will be as Eva imagines.

videos.title: Always Mad
videos.overview: Viri assures the girls that her first time with Alejandro has been perfect. Eva, devastated, ends up confessing to the girls that she has broken up with Jorge and, this time, not even Lucas seems capable of convincing her that they will return.

videos.title: All fucked up
videos.overview: Eva has just reconciled with Jorge, they are as good as they were at the beginning, in love. She is determined not to distrust Jorge more, although she has more and more reasons to. Viri gets herpes from Alejandro... and she is not the only one who has it.

videos.title: The truth first
videos.overview: Lucas makes a very important confession to Eva... she can not take it anymore and also tells him a secret: at the party at Nora's, she got involved with Cristian, should she tell Jorge? Also, the girls accompany Viri to the gynecologist.

videos.title: Eva the Slut
videos.overview: After discovering that Eva got involved with Cristian, Jorge is very angry with her, he does not even want to talk to her ... and the rest of the school, are gossiping. The only one who knew what he had done was Lucas, so Eva believes that it was he who told everyone.

videos.title: Nobody cares
videos.overview: Eva is still bullied at school, the harassment increases, is out of control and Nora is the only one who remains at her side.

videos.title: The end
videos.overview: The girls are furious now that they know that it was Viri who shared the photo of Eva kissing Cristian with Inés. Viri will have to find a way to be part of the group again.

videos.title: Happy New Year!
videos.overview: Eva and her new friends join together to celebrate New Years Eve. At the party she bumps into a few familiar faces...

videos.title: Ecstasy
videos.overview: Cris creates a mess at a party and ends up causing a fight. She also meets Joana, a new high school student, and the two girls end up being assigned to do an assignment together.

videos.title: Frog eyes
videos.overview: Cris goes on a date with Ruben, having a debt with him, while she's not sure about doing the school's assignment with Joana. Nora talks to Alejandro.

videos.title: Lost
videos.overview: Cris stalks Joana and feels like an idiot after seeing her in photos with Eloy. Overwhelmed, she gives up looking for her in school and skips class. Viri suspects that there could be something between Nora and Alejandro. Nora insists that it's just a game.

videos.title: Wishing to swim
videos.overview: Easter break arrives. Eva, Lucas and Cris go out for Chueca and a girl flirts with Cris. Cris gets embarrassed and doesn't react well. Dani pressures Cris to text Rubén back.

videos.title: Punch
videos.overview: Cris is eccentric after her kiss with Joana, even though she flaked on Amira again. Cris thinks she will be angry, but instead America is upset: she thinks that Cris isn't telling her anything anymore because of her religion.

videos.title: Are you a lesbian?
videos.overview: Cris's family leaves for the long weekend. Cris doesn't feel like going. `Even though she loves long weekend breaks, she can't stop thinking about how Lucas was punched. Is that the life that awaits her if she comes out?

videos.title: Stranger
videos.overview: Cris doesn't know what to do when Joana disappears: she realizes that she's in love with someone she doesn't even know. She decides to text Eloy, Joana's ex. She then starts getting texts off people from school asking if she is a lesbian or not.

videos.title: Coward
videos.overview: Joana overwhelms Cris by constantly asking her to meet up, but Cris keeps flaking: she's afraid to confront Joana after her confession. She doesn't think she's able to be with someone with BPD (Borderline Personality Disorder).

videos.title: I can't help it
videos.overview: The party was a disaster, but at least there's some new gossip: what's going on between Eva and Cristian? Eva insists they're just friends, they hook up sometimes and that's all. Nora and Cris find Viri's phone and they give it back to her at her house.

videos.title: Minute by minute
videos.overview: Viri faints because of the stress of exams and Cris takes care of her. Even though Viri assures her that it was low blood pressure, the girls suspect that it's something else. Cris is distraught after her breakup with Joana.

videos.title: The right person, the right moment
Between two worlds
videos.overview: Amira splits her time between Labass club and school. It's becoming more and more clear to her that she has feelings towards Dani but she knows that they would never work together.

videos.title: I'm not wearing a hijab
videos.overview: Without Amira knowing, Dounia starts preparing a surprise... more like a trap?

videos.title: I'm sure Allah understand it
videos.overview: Amira wants to be honest with Kasim once and for all so as to not lead him on but she discovers something unexpected.

videos.title: It's never for Amira
videos.overview: Dani and Amira decide to tell everyone that they're together. Kasim continues to use Amira as a beard to Dounia and his family.

videos.title: Ramadan Kareem
videos.overview: Amira's feelings for Dani begin to grow while tensions rise with her other friends... it seems no matter what she does she always loses.

videos.title: The high school moor
videos.overview: Amira feels guilty about almost having kissed Dani. But, on the other hand she starts to wonder if Islam is demanding too much of her.

videos.title: I don't know anything anymore
videos.overview: Amira confesses to her friends that she's broken up with Dani and they don't seem to understand. She contemplates something that could change everything...

videos.title: The Losers
videos.overview: The squad finally completes their last day of exams. Cris, Nora, Viri and Eva go through it in distinct ways. After the last exam, Amira has a few things to sort out.
